experiment: Traffic-Qwen V1 trained-vs-untrained paired seed comparison
notes: Each trained run starts from the pinned base model and the same V1 training split.
The untrained comparator uses the same Clef decision model with a seed-initialized, untrained decision head and no traffic LoRA adapter.
Each trained/untrained pair uses the same seed and CityFlow Engine seed.
The test split is not used for training or calibration.
The source data is one Jinan episode; these runs do not establish cross-episode generalization.
